PingPongLight Terms of Service

Effective date: 26 November 2026

This page is a translation, for reference only; if it differs from the Chinese version, the Chinese version prevails.

Welcome to PingPongLight (the “game”). By using the game, or by buying paid content in it, you confirm that you have read and agree to these terms. For how personal data is handled, see the Privacy Policy.

1. The service

  • Single-player is free, needs no account, and can be played offline.
  • Online features include the leaderboard, friends and friend messages, online matches, achievements, and levels and light. Online features need a connection and may be interrupted for maintenance or other reasons.
  • “Light” is a point used in the game to enlarge experience: spending light only raises the experience multiplier you earn when you clear a song, and does not affect score, judgment or the leaderboard. Light is not a currency and cannot be transferred, given away or exchanged for cash.
  • Clearing a song in an online match also earns experience (with a bonus by rank and number of players) and does not spend light.
  • If one device starts several rounds at the same time, only the round that started last earns experience.
  • We may change, add or stop some features and values (for example the experience formula or how fast light regenerates); major changes will be announced in the game or on this page.

2. Account and device key

The game has no account, email or password. Your nickname, scores, level, light and purchase records are tied to an ID generated automatically on your device (the device key). So:

  • Deleting the game, clearing the browser’s site data or changing devices loses the device key, and we cannot recover your original nickname, level and light for you.
  • Cosmetics bought in the app can be brought back with “Restore purchases”; light is a consumable purchase with no “Restore purchases”, so once the key is lost, paid light cannot be found again automatically. In that case write to the address in “14. Contact” with Apple’s receipt or transaction ID, and we can help restore it by hand.
  • Please keep your device safe. You are responsible for what is done and spent when someone else uses your device.

3. Paid content

Paid content is offered only inside the iOS app as in-app purchases, and includes:

  • Cosmetics: decorative items such as avatars, nameplate frames, light orbs, trails and backgrounds, kept in your record permanently after purchase.
  • Firefly Jar, Glass Lantern and Starlight Chest: a one-time increase in paid light points. Paid light does not expire, and is used in the order “naturally regenerated light, Moon Cycle Light, paid light”.
  • Moon Cycle Light: named after one full cycle of the moon’s phases. Buy once and, for 30 game days starting on the day of purchase (a game day turns over at 04:00 Taiwan time), 30 points of light are added to your progress record every day. No login is needed; days you were away are made up the next time you connect. The natural regeneration cap of light is also raised during that time. Buying again adds more days; the daily amount stays the same. This light does not expire once granted. It is a consumable item that does not renew automatically and is never charged automatically.

What each item contains and its price are as shown on the purchase screen and in the App Store. Prices may differ by region, tax and exchange rate.

4. Payment and refunds

  • Payment, invoices and refund requests are handled by Apple under Apple’s terms and refund policy; please apply on Apple’s “Report a Problem” page or contact Apple. We cannot request a refund from Apple on your behalf.
  • After Apple approves a refund we receive a notice and take back the light granted by that purchase; light you have already spent is taken back down to 0 at the lowest, never below zero, and your account is not blocked because of it. When Moon Cycle Light is refunded, its days not yet paid out are cancelled, the part already granted is taken back, and its time is shortened accordingly (but never earlier than now). A refunded cosmetic is withdrawn.
  • If you did not receive what you bought, first use “Restore purchases” in the app; if the problem remains, write to the address in “14. Contact” with Apple’s receipt or order number.

5. The seven-day right of withdrawal

Light and cosmetics are digital content whose performance is complete once it is provided. Under Article 19, paragraph 1 of the Consumer Protection Act and the Regulations Governing Reasonable Exceptions to the Right of Withdrawal in Distance Sales, digital content not supplied on a tangible medium is not subject to the unconditional seven-day withdrawal if you have agreed to this in advance. So before you buy, the game asks you to tick that you agree that “the seven-day right of withdrawal no longer applies once the content is provided”, and you can buy only after ticking it. This does not affect your right to ask Apple for a refund under Apple’s policy, nor any right the law does not allow to be excluded.

6. Ending the service and returning unused light

  • When you delete your data: if you still have unused paid light after deleting your online data in the game, we keep only “the hash of the device key, the time of deletion and the points left” for one year, for checking. Within 30 days after deletion you may write to the address in “14. Contact”, attach the proof of purchase, and ask for the unused paid light to be returned; after checking the record we kept, we handle it in proportion to the unused points, through Apple’s refund mechanism or by another reasonable way agreed with you.
  • When we end the service: if we decide to end the game’s online service, we will announce it in the game and on this website at least 30 days before it ends. Within 30 days after the announcement you may write to ask for unused paid light to be returned, handled as above. We will try to keep single-player play available in the app and on the web.
  • Light that is used, or requests made after the periods above, are not covered; this does not affect the rights that the law gives you and does not allow to be excluded.

7. Prohibited conduct

When using the game, please do not:

  • Cheat or undermine fairness, for example by altering or forging scores, tampering with packets or the program, using cheats or automation tools, or exploiting a bug to gain experience, light or leaderboard ranks; if you find a bug, please write and tell us.
  • Harass, insult or threaten other players; send hateful, discriminatory, sexual or violent content; encourage suicide or self-harm; or spam, advertise, scam, ask for personal data or lead people to contact you on another platform (details in “9. Community rules” of the Privacy Policy).
  • Use a nickname that impersonates someone, contains inappropriate words or is personal data.
  • Attack, disrupt or overuse our servers, or try to obtain other people’s data.
  • Resell, rent or trade accounts, light or cosmetics.

8. Reports, actions and suspension

  • You can report a message or player in the game, and you can block the other player. Reported content is judged first by AI and, when AI cannot decide, reviewed by moderators, as described in the Privacy Policy.
  • When a violation is confirmed we may delete the message, suspend sending messages, hide the nickname or void a score, and may stop a serious or repeat offender from using online features. We decide the action by how serious the case is and the accumulated count.
  • If you have questions about an action, you can write to appeal and we will check again; if we confirm that the action was wrong, we will restore it and compensate the paid content affected.

9. Intellectual property

The rights in the game’s program, interface, original songs and art belong to us or to the rights holders who license them to us. For the sources and licenses of songs, sounds and images, see Song and art sources. You may play and share score images for personal, non-commercial purposes, but may not copy, modify, distribute or reverse engineer the game, except where the law allows.

10. Disclaimer and limit of liability

  • The game is provided as it is. We try to keep the service stable, but do not guarantee that it will not be interrupted or have errors, or that the leaderboard and statistics will always be complete.
  • We are not liable for losses caused by failures or maintenance of the network, your device, or third-party services such as Apple, Cloudflare and Vercel, or by other causes we are not responsible for.
  • To the extent the law allows, our liability for damage you suffer from using the game is limited to the amount you actually paid in the 12 months before the event; this does not apply to damage caused by our intent or gross negligence, nor to liability the law does not allow to be limited or excluded (including the rights consumers have under the Consumer Protection Act).

11. Governing law and jurisdiction

These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of China. For disputes arising from these terms or the game, both sides agree that the Taiwan Taipei District Court is the court of first instance; where the law makes a mandatory rule on jurisdiction for consumers, that rule applies.

12. Changes to the terms

We may change these terms as the service or the law changes. When we do, we will update this page and the effective date, and announce major changes (especially the rules on payment, refunds and suspension) in the game or on this page before they take effect, giving you reasonable time to understand them. If you keep using the game after they take effect, you are taken to agree to the changed terms; if you do not agree, please stop using the game, and you may ask for unused paid light to be returned under “6”.

13. Application and severability

If any article of these terms is found invalid or unenforceable, the other articles remain in force. Any translation of these terms into a language other than Chinese is for reference only; if they differ, the Chinese version prevails.

14. Contact
